findings.description: The bucket is explicitly indicated as public and has no private ACL or public-access-block configuration. The customer-master.xlsx object stored here may therefore be exposed to unauthenticated internet access.
No default server-side encryption configuration is defined for this bucket, leaving stored objects without an IaC-enforced encryption-at-rest requirement.
No default server-side encryption configuration is defined for this financial-data bucket, so encryption at rest is not enforced by the configuration.
No default server-side encryption configuration is defined for this bucket, leaving operational data without enforced encryption at rest.
